channel.title: Nvidia is recognized by sysmaint but not by user
channel.description:
Steps to install Nvidia:
https://www.kicksecure.com/wiki/Nvidia#Debian_Repository
Then nvidia will be recognized when running `sudo nvidia-smi` on sysmaint side.
But on user side nvidia is not usable by user because nvidia is within admin level not user.

item.title: Nvidia is recognized by sysmaint but not by user
item.dc:creator: nurmagoz
item.description:
Steps to install Nvidia:

Kicksecure – 21 May 26

Debian Repository - NVIDIA

This option installs the NVIDIA proprietary driver packages from the Debian repositories. It is generally the simplest proprietary driver installation method because it uses Debian packaged software and integrates with the normal APT package...

Then nvidia will be recognized when running sudo nvidia-smi on sysmaint side.

But on user side nvidia is not usable by user because nvidia is within admin level not user.
